observed: The ordinary-store exact non-unit-scale midpoint test failed at index 169: observed 1.75 versus lower-tie oracle 0.875. The CUDA codec divided value by scale before thresholding; fast reciprocal rounding moved an exact constructed midpoint above its boundary.
bounded_fix: Compare value directly against each midpoint multiplied by the stored F32 scale. This removes the reciprocal-rounding ambiguity, preserves the preregistered lower-code tie rule, and changes only the shared E2M1 diagnostic codec.
acceptance: All exact unit/non-unit midpoint and nextafter cases pass, and a mutation restoring normalized division fails the fixed test.
